criteria.tenure_rule: Freehold / 999yr preferred. 99yr included if (a) TOP within 10yr AND < 100 units, OR (b) up to 500 units but some 3BR stacks exceed 1,110 sqft. Show remaining lease + (buyer_age + remaining_lease >= 95) check.
criteria.psf_cap_behaviour: soft — over-cap listings shown with 'cap-exceeded' tag, not excluded

data_reliability: All portals (PropertyGuru, 99.co, EdgeProp, SRX, PropNex) returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch. Figures triangulated from verbatim WebSearch result titles/snippets quoting live listing pages; prices/sizes/PSF reliable to snippet freshness (days-to-weeks), floor/agent/listing-date mostly not exposed. Re-verify live before acting.
buyer_age_note: Buyer age not supplied in task. (buyer_age + remaining_lease >= 95) check computed as minimum passing age = 95 - remaining_lease; all 99yr candidates here have >= 81 yrs left, so any adult buyer passes trivially.
diff_vs_2026_06_06: None of the June-6 baseline picks survive the tightened filters: The Line @ Tanjong Rhu (1,055 sqft) now fails the >1,110 sqft floor; Bliss @ Kovan is a 2BR penthouse (fails >=3BR); prior Flamingo Valley pick was a 2BR. This run is effectively a fresh baseline under the new criteria.
